A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Cox WCM MSM can be used for estimating the causal effect of a time-varying treatment on the hazard in the presence of complex time-varying confoundings and treatment effects.
the Cox WceMsm is a flexible method that allows for complex exposure effects and for the adjustment of time-dependent confoundders that also act as mediating variables.
the Cox WDE MSM is a flexible method to estimate the causal treatment effect in the presence of complex treatment effects and confounding.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cumulative exposure to a time-dependent treatment may have a nonmonotonic effect on the hazard.

the Cox WDE MSM is an attractive option for estimating the cumulative effect of medication on a time-to-event outcome, particularly when there is evidence of time-dependent confounding and/or time-varying treatment effects.

flexible marginal structural Cox models can be used to estimate the cumulative effect of treatment on the hazard in the presence of time-dependent confounding and that these methods can be used in observational studies of the adverse effects of treatment.
